scientific_audit.overall_verdict: The dialogue contains a valuable architectural metaphor, but several biological, quantum, thermodynamic, and AI claims are overstated or incorrect. The architecture below keeps the useful control principle while rejecting unsupported claims.
what_is_well_supported: Piloerection is contraction of arrector pili smooth muscle and is mediated by sympathetic innervation.
Human piloerection can be triggered by thermal, tactile, and audio-visual stimuli; the autonomic pattern can differ by trigger.
Audio-visual piloerection can accompany sympathetic arousal, but self-reported chills and visible piloerection do not always coincide.

Ion-channel selectivity, receptor binding, ATP chemistry, and protein conformational changes ultimately rest on quantum chemistry, while their biological operation is ordinarily modeled with classical electrochemistry, molecular biophysics, kinetics, and statistical mechanics.
Adaptive computation methods can allocate more inference steps or layers to difficult inputs.
Experimental thermodynamic and probabilistic hardware can use physical stochastic dynamics for sampling and linear-algebra primitives.
Maintaining a ledger of rejected hypotheses can be useful for uncertainty estimation, audit, and future learning.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Emotional piloerection is simply the brain mistaking beauty for threat and releasing adrenal adrenaline.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: The pathway is more complex and trigger-dependent. Sympathetic noradrenergic innervation of arrector pili is central; emotional chills are not reliably identical to observed piloerection, and awe does not reliably produce visible piloerection.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Chemical synaptic transmission needs a quantum effect to cross a classically forbidden gap.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: Presynaptic calcium entry triggers regulated SNARE/synaptotagmin-mediated vesicle fusion; neurotransmitter then diffuses across the cleft and binds receptors. Quantum chemistry underlies molecular interactions, but no special macroscopic quantum bridge is required.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: ATP hydrolysis powers myosin by emitting a photon or by billions of coherent quantum transitions.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: ATP hydrolysis is coupled through a biochemical free-energy landscape to conformational changes and force generation. Photon emission is not the operative energy-transfer mechanism, and coherent ensemble quantum transitions are not established.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Piloerection is caused by quantum coherence produced by decoherence.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: Piloerection is a coordinated multiscale physiological response. Decoherence explains why macroscopic biological degrees of freedom behave classically; it is not a demonstrated control signal that creates the reflex.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: A goosebump is direct proof that quantum chaos is converted into order.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: It is acceptable as a philosophical metaphor for local organization in an open, energy-consuming system. Quantum uncertainty, deterministic chaos, thermodynamic entropy, and everyday disorder are distinct concepts and must not be merged.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Body-temperature noise searches an energy landscape and finds the piloerection contraction like simulated annealing.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: The reflex follows neural and biochemical control pathways. Simulated annealing is a useful engineering analogy, not the biological mechanism of arrector pili contraction.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Transformers implement goosebumps in response to cognitive dissonance.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: Attention reweights representations based on learned compatibility. It does not by itself measure bodily salience, contradiction, autonomic arousal, or subjective chills.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: A thermodynamic or homeostatic AI would thereby become alive, conscious, bored, pleased by truth, pained by falsehood, or incapable of lying.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: Adaptive resource allocation and physical energy use do not establish sentience, qualia, moral patienthood, truthfulness, or autonomy. Those remain separate empirical and philosophical questions.

claims_requiring_correction.claim: Variational free-energy minimization is identical to minimizing literal heat or physical energy.
claims_requiring_correction.correction: Variational free energy is an information-theoretic objective. It can be related to physical systems under specific models, but it is not generally the same quantity as electrical power, temperature, or thermodynamic free energy.

safe_reframing.ru: Мурашки не доказывают квантовое упорядочивание хаоса. Зато они дают сильный инженерный образ: множество разных входов сходятся к пороговому событию, после которого организм кратко мобилизует ресурсы и производит наблюдаемое действие. Для ИИ этот образ можно превратить в проверяемый маршрутизатор вычислений — без заявлений о сознании, боли или магической квантовой когерентности.
safe_reframing.en: Goosebumps do not prove quantum ordering of chaos. They do offer a strong engineering pattern: diverse inputs converge on a threshold event, after which an organism briefly mobilizes resources and produces an observable action. For AI, this can become a testable compute router without claims of consciousness, pain, or magical quantum coherence.

existing_components_not_claimed_as_new: probabilistic hardware and stochastic processing units
research_context.proposed_novel_synthesis: The JANUS contribution is the explicit combination of a salience threshold, hysteretic compute mobilization, plural-hypothesis custody, proof-carrying verification, a complete rejected-branch witness ledger, physical resource limits, and a human authority gate under one threshold-guardian architecture.
